name: brownfield
description: Enhance an existing service: link expiry + click budgets, with transient fault and rollback injected
requirement: Links must be able to expire after a configurable TTL, and optionally stop working after a maximum number of clicks. Expired links must return HTTP 410. Existing links must keep working: no breaking API change and no data loss.

design_signoff.comment: Additive nullable columns agreed; rollback plan reviewed.

policy:CHG-002.comment: ALTER TABLE is additive and idempotent.
